$comment: One Expo app at the repo root: the shipped templates (the seed policy, the .npmrc and the gate scripts) over tests/bases/single-app, plus an active dated exclude block and one licence exception.

ops.$comment: Installed and vendored skills (a folder with a SKILL.md) hold planted imports and manifests: the repo scan never reads them.

write.content:
---
name: vendored-skill
description: A planted skill folder; its files hold findings on purpose and must stay invisible.
---

# vendored-skill

---
name: demo-skill
description: A planted skill folder; its files hold findings on purpose and must stay invisible.
---

# demo-skill

---
name: third-party-skill
description: A planted skill folder; its files hold findings on purpose and must stay invisible.
---

# third-party-skill

replace.with:
# min-release-age-exclude[]=<package>

# exclude-block expires=2026-10-10 reason=Expo SDK 57.0.26 pins module patches younger than 7 days
min-release-age-exclude[]=expo
min-release-age-exclude[]=expo-*
min-release-age-exclude[]=@expo/*

value.reason: browser support data, used only by build tools
